ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, in rectangle ABCD, \(AB = 4\), \(BC = 6\). Fold \(\triangle ABC\) along \(AC\), making point \(B\) coincide with point \(E\), and the intersection of \(CE\) and \(AD\) is point \(F\). What is the length of \(DF\)?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} 
Let rectangle ABCD be folded along the diagonal AC so that $\triangle ABC$ falls into the position of $\triangle ACE$,\\
therefore, AE=AB and $\angle E=\angle B=90^\circ$,\\
Furthermore, since ABCD is a rectangle,\\
it follows that AB=CD,\\
thus, AE=DC,\\
and $\angle AFE=\angle DFC$,\\
in triangles $\triangle AEF$ and $\triangle CDF$,\\
\[
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle AFE=\angle CFD \\
\angle E=\angle D \\
AE=CD
\end{array}\right.
\]
thus, $\triangle AEF\cong \triangle CDF$ (AAS),\\
hence, EF=DF;\\
Since ABCD is a rectangle,\\
it follows that AD=BC=6, and CD=AB=4,\\
Since $\triangle AEF\cong \triangle CDF$,\\
it follows that FC=FA,\\
Let FA=x, then FC=x, FD=6−x,\\
in $\triangle CDF$, CF$^{2}$=CD$^{2}$+DF$^{2}$,\\
that is, $x^{2}=4^{2}+(6−x)^{2}$,\\
solving leads to $x=\frac{13}{3}$,\\
therefore, $FD=6−x=\boxed{\frac{5}{3}}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is rectangle ABCD, A is at the upper left, B is at the lower left, C is at the lower right, D is at the upper right; AD is the horizontal side, AB is the vertical side, and BC is the bottom side. Diagonal AC is drawn, and after folding, point B reaches point E above; segment CE passes upward through AD and intersects AD at point F. Reasoning: According to the specified coordinate method, take A=(0,0), B=(0,-4), C=(6,-4), D=(6,0), corresponding to AB=4 and BC=6. The crease is AC, line AC passes through A and C, and its slope is -4/6=-2/3, so the equation is 2x+3y=0. Point E is the reflection of B=(0,-4) about the line 2x+3y=0. Using the reflection formula gives E=(48/13,20/13). Next find the intersection point of line CE and AD. The equation of AD is y=0. Line CE passes through C=(6,-4) and E=(48/13,20/13), and its slope is ((20/13)-(-4))/((48/13)-6)=(72/13)/(-30/13)=-12/5. Therefore the equation of CE can be written as y+4=(-12/5)(x-6). Let y=0, obtaining 4=(-12/5)(x-6), so x-6=-5/3, x=13/3. Thus F=(13/3,0). D=(6,0), so DF=6-13/3=5/3.
